title: Ask Inventory Bot
summary: Ask a question in plain words and get an answer from the same reports you see. It only reads.

blocks.text: Open the chat bubble (website) or Store › Stock › Ask Inventory Bot (app) and ask, for example "what should I order from my dairy vendor?" or "which items are dead stock?".

items: It looks answers up in the real reports: reorder candidates, new order, reconciliation, vendor prices, items sold, price history, dead stock and barcodes. It never makes up a number.
It only reads. It can't log a purchase, confirm a delivery, change a price or write anything.
Each answer says which reports it checked.
Simple lookups go to a fast model; questions that need reasoning go to a stronger one. Each answer says which ran.
With Hide sales numbers, it won't answer sales questions.

blocks.text: It can misunderstand a question. Check important numbers on the report itself before acting on them.
It needs the AI key on [Integrations](page:integrations). Without one, the chat says it isn't set up.
